description: MedMov-XS knowledge base: mobility rules for Medellín. Thresholds are starting values to be agreed with a mobility expert.

rules.name: School zone at school hours

recommend: Ban heavy vehicles on the detour during school entry and exit

rules.because: Heavy detour traffic near a school at entry or exit time raises child pedestrian risk.

rules.name: Unprotected bike lane with more traffic

recommend: Place traffic agents at the detour hotspot
Add temporary separators on the bike lane

rules.because: Flow rises more than 30% on a street whose bike lane has no physical separation.

rules.name: Crash-prone intersection gets more traffic

recommend: Adjust signal timing and post agents at the intersection

rules.because: An intersection with a high crash history receives more than 20% extra flow.

rules.name: Transit stop removed without alternative

recommend: Install a temporary bus stop within 300 m

rules.because: The closure removes a Metroplús or feeder bus stop and there is no alternative stop within 300 m.

rules.name: Bus route delay

recommend: Coordinate a temporary route change with the bus operator

rules.because: The detour adds more than 10 minutes to a bus route on the corridor.

rules.name: Stadium event plus parallel works

recommend: Suspend works on the parallel corridor during the event

rules.because: A massive event at the stadium coincides with active works on a parallel corridor.

rules.name: Crowd at a Metro station entrance

recommend: Request extra Metro staff at the station entrance

rules.because: More than 20,000 people leave the event and the Metro station entrance is on the closed street.

rules.name: Loading zones lost on a commercial street

recommend: Set loading windows before opening hours

rules.because: The detour removes loading zones on a commercial street during business hours.

rules.name: Emergency access blocked

recommend: Guarantee an exclusive emergency route before approving

rules.because: The detour blocks the main access to a hospital or clinic and there is no alternate route.

rules.name: Night through-traffic on a residential street
rules.because: Through-traffic runs on a residential street for more than 60 minutes between 22:00 and 6:00.

rules.name: Mitigation available for high alerts
rules.because: There is at least one HIGH alert and a mitigation exists (agents, alternate route or temporary stop).

rules.name: Several high alerts on one hotspot
rules.because: Two or more HIGH alerts fall on the same intersection, which makes it critical.
